_source: Summaries taken from docs/STATUTORY_AND_LEGAL_COMPLIANCE.md (RailKavach compliance framework). Not the official text: verify against the gazetted text before relying on it in an inquiry or charge sheet.

rules.label: Railways Act s.113
rules.title: Notice of railway accident
rules.summary: Mandatory immediate reporting of collisions, derailments and passenger-train accidents to the District Magistrate, Police and the Commissioner of Railway Safety.

rules.label: Railways Act s.114
rules.title: Inquiry by the Commissioner of Railway Safety
rules.summary: Statutory inquiry by the CRS, who is independent of the Ministry of Railways (under the Ministry of Civil Aviation).

rules.label: Railways Act s.115
rules.title: Inquiry by the railway administration
rules.summary: Departmental joint inquiries headed by the Sr. DSO, Sr. DEE (TRO) and Sr. DOM.

rules.label: Railways Act s.118
rules.title: Powers of the Commission
rules.summary: Powers to summon records, seize electronic logs and inspect rolling stock.

rules.label: Railways Act s.175
rules.title: Endangering safety of persons travelling
rules.summary: A railway servant who, by a rash or negligent act or omission, endangers the safety of any person travelling or being upon a railway is punishable with imprisonment up to two years, or fine, or both. An unverified AI prediction must never be the sole basis of a charge.

rules.label: Railways Act s.179
rules.title: Summary arrest powers
rules.summary: Railway officers and police may arrest without warrant a person committing an offence under Section 175.

rules.label: G&SR 4.40/4.41
rules.title: Calling out of signal aspects
rules.summary: The Loco Pilot and Assistant Loco Pilot must loudly call out signal aspects and point to every signal. Railcomm monitors this exchange.

rules.label: G&SR 4.42
rules.title: Exchange of hand signals
rules.summary: Running crew must exchange hand signals with the Station Master, Gateman and Train Manager. Locate flags HAND_SIGNAL_NOT_RETURNED.

rules.label: G&SR 4.09
rules.title: Caution orders and speed restrictions
rules.summary: Compliance with divisional speed-restriction caution orders. Railcomm matches spoken caution orders against locomotive speed.

rules.label: G&SR 3.78/9.02
rules.title: Signal passed at danger (SPAD)
rules.summary: Passing a signal at Danger is an absolute safety breach and triggers a cross-modal root-cause analysis.

rules.label: RB circular · in-cab phones
rules.title: In-cab mobile phone prohibition
rules.summary: Personal and CUG phones must be switched off and stowed before the train moves. Walkie-talkie (VHF) and the official intercom are permitted.

rules.label: DPDP s.7
rules.title: Legitimate uses
rules.summary: Crew video and audio are processed for state functions under the Railways Act (7(b)) and for employment and safeguarding from liability (7(i)), not on revocable consent.

rules.label: DPDP s.8
rules.title: Obligations of the data fiduciary
rules.summary: Purpose limitation, reasonable security safeguards, breach notification to the Data Protection Board, and erasure when the purpose is served.

rules.label: DPDP ss.11–14
rules.title: Rights of the data principal
rules.summary: Loco pilots may access information, correct inaccurate tags and file grievances; reviewer audit trails support disputes.

rules.label: BSA s.63
rules.title: Admissibility of electronic records
rules.summary: Electronic records need a certificate: Part A by the person in lawful control of the device, Part B by a technical expert certifying the SHA-256 digest.
